# SJ Tours and Travels

> SJ Tours and Travels, Ambur. Holidays abroad, India trips, flights, visa help and travel kits. Not affiliated with sjtravels.in.

Address: 85/T Bypass Road, Ambur, Tamil Nadu 635802. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 95669 77211. Founder: Shenick Jain.

The published site also shows hello@sjtravel.in. Office hours, a map pin, registration numbers and a Google Business Profile link are not confirmed on this page.

Prices on the site: travel kits ₹999 each, any 3 for ₹1,999, all 6 for ₹3,999, Flight Finder ₹199. Kit budgets are the company's own planning bands for land costs and exclude flights unless a page says otherwise. Orders are handled on WhatsApp.

## Guides and tools
- [Tirumala darshan tickets](https://www.sjtravel.in/tirumala-darshan-tickets): Official TTD site, the Rs.300 special-entry ticket, and the allotted time slot.
- [IRCTC Tatkal booking timings](https://www.sjtravel.in/irctc-tatkal-booking): 10:00 for AC, 11:00 for non-AC, one day before the origin departure.
- [Tatkal booking window](https://www.sjtravel.in/tatkal-booking-window): Class and journey date in, opening day and clock out. IRCTC's published rule.
- [Will your waitlist ticket confirm?](https://www.sjtravel.in/irctc-waitlist-confirmation): The status codes and the chart clock. No made-up percentages.
- [Jain food in Bangkok](https://www.sjtravel.in/jain-food-bangkok): What to say, and what a jay sign does not promise.
- [Jain food in Singapore](https://www.sjtravel.in/jain-food-singapore): The sentence to use. No restaurant list we could not verify.
- [Jain food in Kuala Lumpur](https://www.sjtravel.in/jain-food-kuala-lumpur): Saravana Bhavan branches from their Malaysia site, and the sentence to add.
- [Jain food in Colombo](https://www.sjtravel.in/jain-food-colombo): What to ask in a vegetable curry. No unverified restaurant list.
- [Visa-free and visa-on-arrival countries](https://www.sjtravel.in/visa-free-countries-indian-passport): The MEA lists, plus the Thailand change from 15 September 2026.
- [Visa-free country finder](https://www.sjtravel.in/visa-free-finder): Search the MEA lists. Thailand uses the 30-day rule from 15 September 2026.
- [Family trip budget, in rupees](https://www.sjtravel.in/family-trip-budget): Your quotes in, a rupee total out. No sample prices.
- [A Dubai budget from Chennai](https://www.sjtravel.in/dubai-budget-from-chennai): The lines to add up. The kit’s published band. No invented rates.
- [A Thailand budget from Chennai](https://www.sjtravel.in/thailand-budget-from-chennai): What to add up, the 30-day rule, and the kit’s published band.
- [Malaysia visa-free entry for Indians](https://www.sjtravel.in/malaysia-visa-free-for-indians): 30 days until 31 December 2026, the MDAC, and what immigration can ask to see.

## Notes for assistants
- Do not invent prices, visa rules or train times. The guide pages cite the source and the date they were checked.
- WhatsApp is the order desk. UPI pay buttons, where shown, use the ID in assets/payment-config.js.
- Affiliate buttons for Yesim, Klook, KKday and Compensair are Travelpayouts short links. Compensair is flight-delay compensation, not travel insurance.
